items.summary:

HTML files are invisible to stopslop today. `Lang::from_path` (`src/lang.rs:21-34`) has no `html` or `htm` arm, so every `.html`/`.htm` file resolves to `None` and the walker (`walk.rs:47-52`) counts it as skipped rather than linted.
